title: A Movie Review
text:
Last weekend, Deniz watched a new film at the cinema. She wrote a short review for her blog. She said the story was exciting and the actors were good. However, the film was too long.

Her friend Can reads the review before he goes to the cinema. He likes exciting films, so he wants to go. He will buy the tickets on Friday. They will watch the film together.

questions.text: Where did Deniz watch the film?
What did Deniz say was too long?
How does Deniz feel about the film?
options: She liked it, but it was a bit too long
She thinks it was boring and short

questions.text: Why will Can probably go to the cinema?
options: because he wants to work there

vocabulary.definition: a written opinion about a film, book or product
making you feel very interested and energetic
a place where you go to watch films
small pieces of paper that let you enter a place or event

paragraph_translations: Geçen hafta sonu Deniz sinemada yeni bir film izledi. Blogu için kısa bir inceleme yazdı. Hikayenin heyecan verici olduğunu ve oyuncuların iyi olduğunu söyledi. Ancak film çok uzundu.
Arkadaşı Can, sinemaya gitmeden önce incelemeyi okuyor. Heyecan verici filmleri sevdiği için gitmek istiyor. Cuma günü biletleri alacak. Filmi birlikte izleyecekler.
